# Syrtis v0.4.1

Two fixes. No engine change, so no cache rebuild.

## Antigravity quota for people signed in through the `agy` CLI

If you signed in to Antigravity only through the `agy` command-line tool, Syrtis said **"Antigravity is not logged in"** even though you were. It looked for your sign-in where the Antigravity IDE keeps it, and `agy` keeps it somewhere else.

Syrtis now asks `agy` for your quota directly, and the Agent-limits card shows the Gemini and Claude/GPT windows that `agy`'s own `/usage` screen shows.

It only does that when `agy` is installed **and** you are signed in to it. A signed-out `agy` opens a Google sign-in page in your browser when asked for anything, and Syrtis checks every few minutes — so it checks for your saved sign-in first and leaves `agy` alone when there is none.

If a check through `agy` fails, Syrtis stops trying and the card says so, rather than retrying every few minutes. **Restart Syrtis, or sign in to `agy` again, to retry.**

## The turn-count note appears once

The Daily and Monthly lists ended every row with the same note about which clients the turn count covers ("Claude + Codex only"). It is now a single line above the list.
